collection_label: Open research edition with completed numerical replays
document_note: The monograph combines historical results with recovered regional and simulation inputs, completed numerical replays and a new fitted comparison within an autonomous finite-mode subfamily of the stability model.
release_note: All regional cohorts, the frozen New Zealand fit, the complete known-law bank and all matched-generator saved-state scores have been rerun. The autonomous comparison supplies its complete returned states and held-out results. Execution records distinguish these calculations from document and source checks; the repository remains open to review and revision.

historical_s04b_visual_review.scope: Historical S04B integration review; certifies its original pinned artifacts, not the current edition.

historical_s04b_publication_review.scope: Historical S04B integration review; certifies its original pinned artifacts, not the current edition.

review_scope: Internal computational and artifact review. No external academic acceptance is represented.

historical_editorial_visual_review.scope: Historical editorial remediation artifact review. Its original PDF and site hashes are retained; it does not certify the recovered-input edition.

status_meaning: accepted_final and completion_accepted are retained publication-builder state fields: installed production artifacts have passed internal checks. They do not represent scientific closure, journal acceptance or external peer review.

historical_recovered_input_review.scope: Historical first recovered-input publication; certifies its original 233-page artifact.

current_edition_visual_review.scope: Internal production review of the installed completed-replay edition, with exact document/site hashes and visual scope.
